about: South Bruce Peninsula is a town in Bruce County, Ontario, covering Wiarton, Sauble Beach, and the southern peninsula—not Northern Bruce Peninsula (Tobermory) and not a single beach village. Niagara Escarpment cliffs, Georgian Bay at Wiarton, and the long Lake Huron sand beach at Sauble define the municipality. About 9,000 people live in South Bruce Peninsula.
seoSummary: Bruce County town of Wiarton and Sauble Beach—southern peninsula, not Tobermory or Northern Bruce Peninsula.
